title: Show Day Routine
hook_vo: Show day, without surprises: four checks that keep the screens up.

beats.vo: Run the show once. A red card means a file is missing; relink it.
Lock editing while live, so a stray drag can't change the show.
A cable comes out? Plug it back in, and the screen comes right back.
And make the cards big, so they're easy to hit in a dark booth.
